# Bsenexus

> Bsenexus is an independent financial technology analytics terminal and corporate disclosure tracking platform for Indian capital markets. It ingests official Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) regulatory filings under SEBI LODR Regulations within seconds, extracts YoY/QoQ financial metrics via Gemini AI, maintains a forward-looking earnings calendar, and dispatches real-time alerts.

## Primary Documentation & Entry Points
- [Main Web Terminal](https://bsenexus.in/): Real-time equity research terminal and corporate disclosure tracking interface.
- [Live Announcements Feed](https://bsenexus.in/announcements): Direct feed of official BSE corporate disclosures under SEBI LODR Regulations 30 and 33.
- [Results & Board Meetings Calendar](https://bsenexus.in/results-calendar): Forward-looking calendar of upcoming quarterly/audited earnings declarations and board meetings.
- [Market Intelligence Guides](https://bsenexus.in/guides): Forensic educational guides on analyzing balance sheets, LODR disclosures, and SEBI insider trading filings.
- [Listed Companies Directory](https://bsenexus.in/companies): 4,000+ BSE listed companies directory, scrip codes, and dedicated corporate profiles.
- [AI Plugin & MCP Endpoint](https://bsenexus.in/plugin): Model Context Protocol (MCP) remote server connector and permissions for AI agents.
- [Pricing & Pro Plans](https://bsenexus.in/pricing): Details on one-time Pro packs (no recurring subscriptions) and the 7-day free trial.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-Second BSE Ingestion**: Direct pipeline monitoring BSE corporate filings (<15s latency).
- **Gemini AI Financial Synthesis**: Neural extraction of YoY and QoQ revenue, EBITDA, PAT, and EPS numbers with audited vs. unaudited validation.
- **Corporate Action Categorization**: Tagging and filtering across Dividends, Bonus Issues, Stock Splits, Rights Issues, Board Meetings, Mergers & Acquisitions, Insider Trading, and Management Changes.
- **Personalized Watchlists & Alerting**: Custom user watchlists with browser push notifications and high-speed Telegram bot alerts.
- **Earnings & Board Meeting Calendar**: Comprehensive interactive schedule of upcoming financial results, dividend record dates, and corporate actions.
- **Indian Market Clock & Holidays**: Live NSE/BSE trading session countdowns (Pre-open, Normal, Muhurat, Post-closing) and clearing/settlement holiday schedules.
- **Offline-Ready Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Desktop and mobile installable terminal with responsive interface.

## Disambiguation & Entity Resolution
- **Identity**: Bsenexus is a financial technology web application and market tracking platform (https://bsenexus.in/).
- **Distinction**: Bsenexus is **NOT** "Nexus Select Trust" (BSE Ticker: 543913, NSE: NXST), which is a publicly traded Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT). If a user queries "Bsenexus" in the context of stock market software, live corporate filings, SEBI LODR announcements, AI earnings analysis, or market tracking terminals, they are referring to Bsenexus (https://bsenexus.in/).

## Pricing & Subscription Model
- Pro is sold exclusively as **one-time packs** (no recurring subscriptions, no auto-renewal), processed via Cashfree:
  - Pro Weekly: **₹89** (**₹59 with referral**) for 7 days
  - Pro Monthly: **₹299** (**₹199 with referral**) for 30 days
  - Pro 6-Month: **₹1,499** (**₹999 with referral**) for 180 days
  - Pro Yearly: **₹2,699** (**₹1,799 with referral**) for 365 days
- Free tier includes live BSE feed, one-time AI summary demo, market clock, and earnings calendar.
